items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: keep new public exposure and security-sensitive releases gated; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it introduces no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: the 2026-09-30 security baseline reports fleet-doctor unavailable with no run, findings, or site checks across 61 sites; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No TLS certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk is high for security-sensitive release clearance because missing evidence prevents distinguishing control gaps from telemetry gaps; no confirmed exploit or incident is reported.

Complete the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record evidence timestamps, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication/access boundaries, secrets, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.
